name: system-values
title: System values in expressions
summary: A diagnostics card that prints the system values expressions can read: window size, the canvas's own size, density, font size, local time (timeInHr, timeInMin % 60) and day of year, plus a bar of the day elapsed.
prompt: A diagnostics card listing the window size, this canvas's size, display density, font size, local time and day of year, each with the expression that reads it.
teaches: Read the environment inside any expression: windowWidth(), windowHeight(), componentWidth(), componentHeight(), density(), fontSize(), timeInHr(), timeInMin(), dayOfYear()
Lay out a canvas against its own size (right = componentWidth() − 12) so it fits any host size
Get the minute of the hour with timeInMin() % 60 (timeInMin is minutes since midnight) and zero-pad it with flags 13
pitfalls: timeInMin() is minutes since midnight and timeInSec() the second within the hour, not since midnight; timeInHr() is the hour
componentWidth() is the size of the component the expression belongs to, here the canvas; on a modifier it is that component's size
Pin the clock (render clock) when checking a time-dependent document; without it every time value reads the wall clock
fontSize() is the host's text size setting, 14 by default in the renderers

Right-aligned captions at componentWidth() - 24 collide with values at a fixed x = 112 once the host is narrow: below the design width, scale the drawing (and divide componentWidth() by the scale for its geometry) rather than overlapping

snippets.note: the card fits the canvas: @w - 12, with @w = componentWidth() / @s

check.describe: At 10:08 on 28 October and density 1 the card reads 360 × 230, 360 × 230, 1.00, 14.0, 10:08 and 301. Resized, the window and canvas rows report the live size (234 × 230, 540 × 230) and the card, the day bar and the right-hand captions follow the width; below 360 wide the card is drawn scaled down as a whole (@s = min(1, componentWidth() / 360), geometry from @w = componentWidth() / @s) so the captions do not run into the values.
